candidates.name: Idle backlight dimming with interaction restore
candidates.user_value: Reduces glare and power while restoring normal brightness immediately when the user interacts.
candidates.implementation_cost: Small isolated monotonic-time policy module and one-second app brightness update using existing GPIO6 backlight control.
candidates.risk: Incorrect active-low handling or timeout behavior could leave the display too dim.
candidates.verification_method: Host CTest boundary and interaction tests, then operator optical check of dim and restore behavior.
candidates.selection_reason: Uses a documented existing resource, stays separate from the core receiver, and has the lowest implementation and verification risk of the three candidates.

candidates.name: IMU orientation-based display rotation
candidates.user_value: Keeps the dashboard readable when the board is mounted at a different angle.
candidates.implementation_cost: Requires IMU startup, orientation filtering, thresholds, debounce and rotated page layouts.
candidates.risk: Desk motion or ambiguous resting angle could rotate the core UI unexpectedly.
candidates.verification_method: Operator records fixed orientations, motion noise, return behavior and interaction overlap.
candidates.selection_reason: Adds sensor and layout state with a higher risk of disrupting the fixed landscape UI; this run cannot observe the board motion cases.

candidates.name: Battery status display
candidates.user_value: Shows remaining power before the board loses power unexpectedly.
candidates.implementation_cost: Needs ADC channel and divider confirmation, calibration, null handling and battery-specific tests.
candidates.risk: An absent battery or uncalibrated input could show a misleading charge level.
candidates.verification_method: Confirm the board circuit and compare readings with known input conditions and a fitted battery.
candidates.selection_reason: The supplied board facts do not establish battery installation or calibrated voltage readings, so a reliable feature cannot be verified in this run.
